context: Asuka and Riku discuss science since an old discovery.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science discussion; formal vocabulary (自体/とともに/以来/以降/いずれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この発見は、いつ以来有名なんですか?
lines.en: Since when has this discovery been famous?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発表以来、世界中で知られています。
lines.en: Since its announcement, it's known worldwide.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 理論自体は、難しいんですか?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 理論自体は、意外と単純です。
lines.en: The theory itself is surprisingly simple.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それ以降、研究は進んだんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それ以降、技術とともに発展しました。
lines.en: Since then, it developed along with technology.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いずれ、僕も研究してみたいです。
lines.en: Eventually, I want to research it too.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, soft warm bright engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いずれ、君とともに学べると嬉しいですね。
lines.en: I'd be glad to eventually learn alongside you.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
